notes: Holistic cross-component code audit of feature 13-funnels-tooling (tasks 1-6, commits b313524, 76237e0+5eb47cc, d356f55, 8a5e92e, e6f765d, 1aa1bc2). No dead code, no naming drift, no inconsistent error handling found between task seams. Lead does NOT need to spawn a fixer.
